capabilities: Browse all Windows drives and folders with search, previews, right-click menus and drag-and-drop
Compress and extract ZIP, 7z, RAR, TAR and other archive formats via 7-Zip or PowerShell
Convert Word/Excel/PPT to PDF, merge and split PDFs, batch print and convert formats via WPS Office
Batch rename files with regex find-and-replace and preset rules with preview
Store multiple copy/cut batches in a multi-slot clipboard that also writes to the system clipboard
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not just a drive launcher; it is a full file explorer with previews, archiving, conversion, renaming and clipboard features.
extras: Windows only (no macOS/Linux support). Requires manual installation of main.js and manifest.json into the plugins folder. The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice. Documentation is in Chinese.
intentEvidence: 把文件资源管理器做成了 Obsidian 插件。
motivation: The README frames it as turning the Windows File Explorer into an Obsidian plugin so users never need to leave the app to browse their disks.
problem: Working with files outside the vault requires switching to the Windows File Explorer; this puts drive browsing and file operations directly inside Obsidian.
summary: Windows File Explorer embedded in Obsidian for browsing drives, previewing files, archiving, WPS-powered document conversion, batch renaming, and multi-slot clipboard.
